name: Hello Counsel 💋
source:
Josephine, better known as the sensational criminal thrillseeker Poise, just got arrested! Good thing, her hot lawyer boyfriend Salem is here to help her avoid any jail time — only if she stops flirting with him, that is.

The right to counsel involves counseling from both parties, right? 

[from [url=https://miseri-accordion.itch.io/hello-counsel]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
约瑟芬被捕了！比起本名，她更为人熟知的身份，是轰动一时、追求刺激的罪犯“Poise”。好在，她帅气的律师男友塞勒姆前来相助，争取让她免受牢狱之灾——前提是，她得先停止调戏他。

获得律师协助的权利，也包括双方互相“开导”，对吧？

[摘自[url=https://miseri-accordion.itch.io/hello-counsel]itch.io[/url]]
